line: push    ebp; Oblivion per-source shadow-map producer. Binds and clears the pooled R32F texture plus shared compatible depth/stencil, installs the full-map projector viewport, draws mode-5 caster buckets, captures matrices, and ends the target. The texture buffer uses its own level-0 D3D surface and requires no end-of-target copy or resolve.
mov     al, [ebx+0F4h]; Normal per-source rendering checks +0xF4 together with renderer/shader class >=3 and shadow feature bit 0x10.
cmp     byte ptr [ebx+120h], 0; Shadow map generation is eligible when the ordinary +0xF4/class/feature gate succeeds or +0x120 overrides that gate; status +0x118 and fade +0xD8 still gate rendering.
call    BSTextureManager__BorrowFrustumShadowTexture; Borrow one BSRenderedTexture from the unused frustum-shadow pool when +0x114 is null.
call    ShadowSceneLight_SetShadowMap; Publish/strong-own the borrowed shadow texture at ShadowSceneLight+0x114.
fstp    [esp+214h+var_1F8]; Build shadow-camera view ray from exact source world-bound center toward backing projector branch world position.

call    Vector3_NormalizeInPlace; Vector3_NormalizeInPlace. Returns original length in ST0; if length <= epsilon at 0xA372CC, zeroes xyz and returns 0. PlaceAtMe uses it to normalize the ray hit vector before scaling by hit distance.

call    NiPoint3__NormalizedCrossProduct; Computes and normalizes the cross product of two NiPoint3 vectors, returning zero for near-degenerate input. ShadowSceneLight uses it to construct an orthonormal shadow-camera basis.

call    NiPoint3__NormalizedCrossProduct; Computes and normalizes the cross product of two NiPoint3 vectors, returning zero for near-degenerate input. ShadowSceneLight uses it to construct an orthonormal shadow-camera basis.
mov     eax, [ebx+130h]; Load exact caster/source root +0x130 for map-camera construction.
mov     esi, [ebx+100h]; Load backing projector branch +0x100 for map-camera construction.
fld     dword ptr [eax+2Ch]; Read uncapped exact-source world-bound radius for native shadow-camera coverage.
fstp    [esp+214h+var_1F0]; Read uncapped exact-source world-bound radius for the retail lateral-frustum calculation.
fstp    [esp+214h+var_1E8]; Compute source-center to backing-branch distance.
fld     [esp+214h+var_1F0]; Compute the native projector field of view in degrees as (exact caster radius / source-to-projector distance) * 110.0.
fstp    [esp+214h+var_1F0]; Native projector FOV in degrees = caster radius / source-to-projector distance * 110.0.
fst     dword ptr [ebx+124h]; Store the native projector FOV in degrees at ShadowSceneLight+0x124.
fmul    qword ptr ds:0A2FAA0h; Convert the stored field of view to its half-angle in radians: FOV * 0.5 * 0.01745327934622765.
fstp    [esp+214h+var_1F0]; Continue retail lateral-frustum scale calculation.
call    __CItan; Apply tan(FOV/2) to obtain the symmetric lateral-frustum extent used by the Oblivion shadow camera.
fstp    [esp+214h+var_1F0]; Continue retail lateral-frustum scale calculation.
fst     [esp+214h+a2]; Perspective frustum left and bottom are -tan(FOV/2).
fst     [esp+214h+var_198]; Perspective frustum right and top are +tan(FOV/2).
fst     [esp+214h+var_194]; Complete symmetric shadow-camera lateral-frustum commit.
fst     [esp+214h+var_18C]; Per-source shadow camera near plane is 1.0.
fld     dword ptr [esi+0F8h]; Read backing point-light range +0xF8 for the shadow-camera far plane.
fstp    [esp+214h+var_188]; Per-source shadow camera far plane comes from the observed source/caster state.

call    BSShaderManager_IsShadowMappingReady; [Verified] Returns true only when BSShaderPackageVersion (RendererGlobalState+0xAF) >= 3 and BSShaderFeatureMask (RendererGlobalState+0xA7) contains native shadow-map bit 0x10. The version comparison independently corroborates the selector field read by GetShaderProgramPackageIndex.
add     ebx, 14Ch; ShadowSceneLight+0x14C owns the lazily allocated per-source shadow camera.

For a NiNode root these resolve to NiNode_UpdateDownwardPass and NiNode_UpdateParentWorldBounds.

call    NiCullingProcess__SetFrustum; Oblivion NiCullingProcess::SetFrustum copies the camera frustum, rebuilds six culling planes, and sets the active-plane mask to 0x3F.

call    NiRenderer_EndScene; End the per-source target after view/projection matrices were captured. This drains the target stack and does not restore viewport or scissor state.
call    NiDX9Renderer__SetShaderAccumulator; Restore the renderer's previous shader accumulator.
